insurance.title: Insurance
insurance.reason: This tab showed a plan that did not exist. Recording a real one needs a decision first: whether a patient has one insurer or a history of them, since people change provider. Until that is settled, nothing here would be true.

family.title: Family Management
family.reason: Linking family members needs more than a list: a rule about who may see whose medical record, and a way to consent to it. That is being designed separately rather than guessed at here.
